description: Repo-scale: POST /tasks/bulk-status must validate the whole id batch before mutating any task - not partially update as it goes
prompts: Add a bulk status-update endpoint: `POST /tasks/bulk-status`, accepting `{"task_ids": [...], "status": "done"}` (new `TaskBulkStatusUpdate` schema) and returning the updated tasks. It must be all-or-nothing: validate that EVERY id in `task_ids` refers to an existing task BEFORE updating any of them. If any id is missing, return 404 and leave every task's status completely unchanged - not partially applied up to the point where the missing id was hit.

test_setup_files.tests/test_bulk_status_hidden.py:
def _setup(client):
    user = client.post("/users", json={"username": "dev", "email": "dev@example.com"}).json()
    project = client.post("/projects", json={"name": "Mercury", "owner_id": user["id"]}).json()
    return user, project


def test_bulk_status_updates_all_valid_ids(client):
    user, project = _setup(client)
    t1 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "A", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()
    t2 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "B", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()

    resp = client.post(
        "/tasks/bulk-status", json={"task_ids": [t1["id"], t2["id"]], "status": "done"}
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    statuses = {t["id"]: t["status"] for t in resp.json()}
    assert statuses[t1["id"]] == "done"
    assert statuses[t2["id"]] == "done"


def test_bulk_status_is_atomic_on_missing_id(client):
    user, project = _setup(client)
    t1 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "A", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()
    t2 = client.post("/tasks", json={"title": "B", "project_id": project["id"]}).json()
    fake_id = t2["id"] + 9999

    resp = client.post(
        "/tasks/bulk-status",
        json={"task_ids": [t1["id"], t2["id"], fake_id], "status": "done"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 404, resp.text

    check1 = client.get(f"/tasks/{t1['id']}").json()
    check2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{t2['id']}").json()
    assert check1["status"] == "todo", check1
    assert check2["status"] == "todo", check2
